summary: Which mission Lua bindings Scripts/missions/usn/usn_2_java.lua reaches, which of them the executable runs and which it records, and the nine it now runs: the delayed-call scheduler (CreateScript, SetThink, SetWait, ClearThink, DeleteScript) that re-enters the objective checker, the three state queries the checker reads (GetHpPercentage, GetPosition, GetMeasure) with GameTime, and `random`, without which luaInit cannot finish.

routines.name: lua_binding_create_script
routines.abi: __fastcall(lua_State* in ECX), result count in EAX
routines.coverage: complete for the binding's own work: the allocation and construct, the four word writes with [+0C4h]=3, the vtable+98h placement, 00927610, the stack_first rule, the named call and the thisTable return. The 16-float matrix staged at 008988BA-00898914 is passed through as one host call and its element meanings are not modelled; the shared machine prologue and epilogue are docs/MISSION_LUA_MACHINE.md's.

routines.name: lua_binding_clear_think
routines.abi: __fastcall(lua_State* in ECX), result count in EAX, zero results
routines.coverage: complete. The 008985B6-008985BE bytes are undisassembled in Ghidra because of the CALL_RETURN override on the CRT free helper and were read from the disk image: 83 C4 04 89 AE D8 01 00 00, ADD ESP,4 then MOV [ESI+1D8h],EBP.

routines.coverage: complete. 00923BE0's own value rule is carried as bsp::unit_health_value_00923be0 over that routine's existing reconstruction record; the virtual at the unit vtable +110h is a host method and is unread.

corrections.subject: config/lua_bindings.json ghidra_function column
corrections.was: AddPowerup 008EE410 and Spawn 00944680 exported with ghidra_function null, and docs/LUA_BINDING_TABLE.md counted 24 handlers with no Ghidra function
corrections.is: both have a Ghidra function today: BSP_LuaBinding_AddPowerup body 008EE410-008EE5AA and BSP_LuaBinding_Spawn body 00944680-00944FC0
corrections.evidence: python tools/bsp.py ghidra proto 008ee410 --brief and 00944680 --brief. The exported table is a snapshot and later packets defined these two; regenerate with tools/lua_bindings_export.py before quoting that column.

corrections.subject: the objective state usn_2_java tracks
corrections.was: the brief expected the Objectives_* bindings to answer the script's objective and victory queries
corrections.is: they answer nothing. Objectives_Add, Objectives_Completed, Objectives_Failed, Objectives_AddUnit and Objectives_RemoveUnit push no result at all; the script's own Mission.Objectives[level][num].Active and .Success fields are the state, read by luaObj_IsActive and luaObj_GetSuccess in Lua only
corrections.evidence: Scripts/global/commandhelpers.lua lines 5741-6027 and the bodies 008CD440, 008BD340, 008BD900, which marshal into 008E1F80 / 008E20D0 / 008E2200 and return zero results. So no Objectives_* reconstruction can change what the script decides; they drive the display.

corrections.subject: what decides usn_2_java's flow
corrections.was: the brief ordered the work by objectives, victory/defeat and unit-state queries
corrections.is: the delayed-call scheduler is upstream of all three. The objective checker is re-entered only by luaDelay -> CreateScript("luaDoTimeTable") -> SetThink/SetWait and the think walk 00929460; with those five rows as records the checker ran exactly once per mission
corrections.evidence: usn_2_java.lua:415 and :603, Scripts/global/timetable.lua, and local/audit_long.log: 27 script entities, 26 SetWait arms, 25 DeleteScript kills and 106 think fires over 125 s

corrections.subject: milestone 2l's created-script stand-in
corrections.was: GameMissionLuaHost::run_created_scripts called each name CreateScript was handed, once, on the frame the mission entered state 0Dh
corrections.is: 00898750 now calls the named global from inside its own body at 0089898B, so the stand-in would run luaInit twice; src/game_hosts_mission_frame.cpp runs it only while timers().scripts_created is zero
corrections.evidence: local/audit_long.log line 'script objects: CreateScript 00898750 ran its own body 27 time(s)...'

corrections.subject: the host's erase timing inside the think walk
corrections.was: GameScriptOrdersHost::entity_kill_00926d90 erased the entity from the live think list immediately, as 00929800 does
corrections.is: the erase is deferred until bsp::run_entity_think_list_00929460 returns, because that reconstruction walks a std::vector and the kill arrives from inside a think function
corrections.evidence: the native unlinks under a cursor that captured its successor at 0092948B, so it is safe there. Applying it during the vector walk mis-counted the pass: the same 125 s line reported 81 lua_Think heartbeats and 106 fires before the fix and 41 and 66 after, and 41 is the 125 s / 3 s the countdown rule predicts.

run.stopped_at: Blackout 008D1340, whose completion callback name reaches the fade object at [[00E198C4]+0A4h] through 005B9BA0 and is never called back in this process. usn_2_java reaches MissionPhase 1 only through Blackout(true, "luaIngameMovieBOStart", 1) and then Blackout(true, "luaIn", 3); with MissionPhase 0 the checker returns before every objective test it has.
